name: NIST National Vulnerability Database (NVD)
summary: CVE records enriched by NIST with CVSS scores, CWE weaknesses, CPE applicability and KEV dates, their change history, and the CPE product dictionary.

api_key.description: Optional NVD API key (nvd.nist.gov/developers/request-an-api-key), sent in the apiKey header; it raises the rate limit tenfold.

notes: Rate limit per rolling 30 seconds: 5 requests without a key, 50 with one; NIST still asks for a pause of a few seconds between requests. Excess requests are blocked by the firewall.
Any date range (published, modified, KEV, change) must have both ends and span at most 120 consecutive days.
Paging is offset-based: read totalResults and repeat with startIndex advanced by resultsPerPage.
Value-less flags (hasKev, noRejected, keywordExactMatch, isVulnerable and similar) are documented as bare query keys and are not in these entries.
NIST asks applications to show: 'This product uses data from the NVD API but is not endorsed or certified by the NVD.'

endpoints.name: Search CVEs
endpoints.summary: CVE records with NVD's CVSS, CWE, CPE configurations, references and KEV fields, filtered by ID, keyword, product, severity or date.

keywordSearch.description: Words that must all appear in the current description (prefix match on each word).

cpeName.description: A CPE 2.3 name; part, vendor, product and version must not be '*'. Returns the CVEs whose applicability matches it.

virtualMatchString.description: A CPE match string, broader than cpeName; ignored when cpeName is also sent.

versionStart.description: Start of a version range; needs versionStartType and virtualMatchString.

versionEnd.description: End of a version range; needs versionEndType and virtualMatchString.

cveTag.description: Only records carrying this CVE tag.

cvssV3Severity.description: CVSS v3 qualitative severity. Not combinable with the v2 or v4 severity.

cvssV4Severity.description: CVSS v4 qualitative severity. Not combinable with the v2 or v3 severity.

cvssV2Severity.description: CVSS v2 severity; NVD stopped scoring v2 in July 2022.

cvssV3Metrics.description: Full or partial CVSS v3 vector string.

cvssV4Metrics.description: Full or partial CVSS v4 vector string.

cweId.description: Weakness ID; NVD-CWE-Other and NVD-CWE-noinfo also work.

sourceIdentifier.description: Only CVEs from this data source.

pubStartDate.description: Published from; needs pubEndDate. Extended ISO-8601, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z; give a '+' offset as is, since the call encodes it.

pubEndDate.description: Published until; needs pubStartDate. Extended ISO-8601, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z; give a '+' offset as is, since the call encodes it.

lastModStartDate.description: Last modified from; needs lastModEndDate. Extended ISO-8601, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z; give a '+' offset as is, since the call encodes it.

lastModEndDate.description: Last modified until; needs lastModStartDate. Extended ISO-8601, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z; give a '+' offset as is, since the call encodes it.

kevStartDate.description: Added to CISA KEV from; needs kevEndDate. Extended ISO-8601, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z; give a '+' offset as is, since the call encodes it.

kevEndDate.description: Added to CISA KEV until; needs kevStartDate. Extended ISO-8601, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z; give a '+' offset as is, since the call encodes it.

resultsPerPage.description: Records per response; default and maximum 2,000.

startIndex.description: Zero-based index of the first record; add resultsPerPage until totalResults is reached.

notes: Leave every filter out to page through the whole database, sorted by published date.
A 200 with no results can mean the filter matched nothing, not an error; a 4xx usually means a filter value or combination NVD rejects.

endpoints.name: Get CVE change history
endpoints.summary: Change events (analysis, modification, rejection, KEV updates) for CVEs, with what was added, changed or removed.

changeStartDate.description: Changed from; needs changeEndDate. Extended ISO-8601, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z; give a '+' offset as is, since the call encodes it.

changeEndDate.description: Changed until; needs changeStartDate. Extended ISO-8601, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z; give a '+' offset as is, since the call encodes it.

resultsPerPage.description: Events per response; default and maximum 5,000.

startIndex.description: Zero-based index of the first event.

endpoints.name: Search the CPE product dictionary
endpoints.summary: CPE names and titles from the Official CPE Dictionary, to find the cpeName a CVE search needs.

keywordSearch.description: Words that must all appear in the CPE title or reference links.

cpeMatchString.description: A CPE match string; returns every dictionary name it matches.

matchCriteriaId.description: CPE names for a match-criteria UUID, as found in a CVE's configurations.

lastModStartDate.description: Modified from; needs lastModEndDate. Extended ISO-8601, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z; give a '+' offset as is, since the call encodes it.

lastModEndDate.description: Modified until; needs lastModStartDate. Extended ISO-8601, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z; give a '+' offset as is, since the call encodes it.

resultsPerPage.description: Records per response; default and maximum 10,000.

startIndex.description: Zero-based index of the first record.
